dataset.name: YSH esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma cohort (GSE130078)
dataset.description: Independent Korean esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma cohort with paired-tissue bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Yonsei Severance Hospital prospectively enrolled 66 patients with esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma. Twenty-three patients have paired tumor and adjacent-noncancer RNA sequencing in GSE130078; TRACE Explorer retains one source-labelled tumor profile per patient and links it to the exact public overall-survival record.
dataset.publication_citation: You et al. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 2019

metadata.source_program: Yonsei Severance Hospital prospective ESCC cohort
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus plus the PNAS supplementary clinical workbook distributed through Europe PMC
metadata.library_method: Ribosomal-RNA-depleted stranded total-RNA sequencing of paired tumor and adjacent mucosa; Sickle quality filtering, STAR 2.5.2b alignment to GRCh37/hg19 and featureCounts 1.5.1 quantification against GENCODE v19
metadata.endpoint_context: Overall survival in days with source vital status Alive or Dead
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The public clinical workbook labels the interval Days OS but does not state whether day zero is diagnosis, biopsy, enrollment or another clinical landmark. TRACE Explorer therefore preserves a source-defined OS origin.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: PNAS Dataset S6 contains 66 unique Patient_01 through Patient_66 records with Days OS and Vital status. The first 23 identifiers correspond exactly to the 23 paired-tissue RNA-seq patients in GEO; all have positive time and explicit status, yielding seven deaths and 16 censored observations.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Only GEO titles ending in _cancer and only supplementary count files ending in _cancer.assigned_count.txt.gz are eligible. All 23 paired adjacent-normal profiles are excluded before endpoint evaluation.
metadata.expression_processing_note: Each retained tumor file contains the same ordered 57,783 versioned Ensembl gene identifiers and one raw assigned-count column. All identifiers map to pinned GENCODE v19. TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM over all source rows, applies log2(CPM + 1) and excludes 293 symbols represented by multiple source Ensembl genes, retaining 55,431 analyzable symbols.
metadata.overlap_note: The Korean YSH cohort is independent of TCGA-ESCA and of the active Vanderbilt, Humanitas and Big Ten durvalumab esophageal-cancer releases.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public files in place. Source redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms and the article's CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 license remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma tumor, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: GEO featureCounts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned GENCODE v19 GRCh37 gene_name annotation used by the source pipeline
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 57,783 source Ensembl identifiers map to GENCODE v19. The 293 symbols assigned to more than one source Ensembl gene are excluded rather than silently combined, leaving 55,431 analyzable symbols.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library-size CPM across all 57,783 source rows for each selected tumor, applies log2(CPM + 1), maps GENCODE v19 Ensembl identifiers and excludes ambiguous symbols. Values are intended for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by Vital status (Dead = event; Alive = censored)
